title: rumex infestus
intro: Rumex infestus, commonly known as the common sorrel or sheep sorrel, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and treat digestive issues, due to its high levels of vitamin C and antioxidants. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Rumex infestus include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
